description:
Team and role overview
  
  
The Infrastructure & Climate team invests across essential infrastructure sectors including energy, transport, logistics and utilities through a combination of direct infrastructure equity investments, infrastructure and climate funds, and strategic co-investments. In Southeast Asia, the team is focused on supporting sustainable infrastructure development, accelerating the energy transition, and building climate resilience across key markets including Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Thailand.
  
  
Based in Singapore, the Southeast Asia team plays a central role in delivering BII's regional Infrastructure & Climate strategy, working closely with colleagues across Asia and London to identify, originate, execute and actively manage investments that deliver both strong commercial returns and measurable development impact. The team combines local market expertise with BII's global investment platform, leveraging deep relationships with developers, operators, financial sponsors, commercial banks, DFIs and other strategic partners across the region.
  
  
Over the coming years, the team will be responsible for deploying across existing and new equity platforms, building scalable businesses that support sustainable economic growth and climate objectives in the region. As the platform continues to expand, the team will play an increasingly important role in shaping BII's presence in Southeast Asia while contributing insights, expertise and collaboration across the wider Infrastructure & Climate business, including the growing equity platforms portfolio in India.

Review and comment on legal documentation together with the internal legal team.

Coordinate and assist in preparing and presenting high-quality investment proposals through BII's investment process as well as the preparation and presenting monitoring papers for existing deals.
  
  
Inclusively manage the engagement of support teams (Environmental, Social, Business Integrity and Development Impact), ensuring all internal stakeholders can achieve their objectives.
  
  
Deal Execution & Portfolio Monitoring
  
  
Assist in delivering a high quality, diversified portfolio of transactions in the region.
  
  
Ensure the maintenance of a high-quality portfolio post-disbursement including financials, development impact and environmental, social and business integrity, leveraging internal specialists as needed.

Contribute to Strategic and Other Internal Initiatives
  
  
Work with the other investment teams in I&C including Direct Private Equity, Private Equity Funds and Project Finance teams to collaboratively steer the business growth development and monitoring in accordance with strategic objectives.
  
  
Contribute to other ad hoc internal initiatives, strategic or otherwise.
  
  
The candidate
  
  
**Successful candidates will have a proven track record in:**  
Deep network in Southeast Asia across banks, DFIs and sustainable infrastructure businesses built through previous infrastructure transaction experience in energy, water, ports, or transport, preferably with an international bank; Development Financial Institution or Multilateral Development Institution;

description:
Bring your energy to Aggreko as a **QHSE Officer – Environmental Health & Safety** to be based in our depot in **Johor, Malaysia.** This role will support the effective implementation of QHSE policies and procedures and assist in driving a safe work culture of QHSE at depot and site locations across Malaysia, Thailand and Singapore.

Power without pause. Heating, cooling and oil-free air without end. We keep our customers’ worlds on. From world-class events that last a few weeks to mining operations and remote communities who rely on us for decades.

**What you’ll do as a QHSE Officer:**

* **Implement and Ensure Compliance:** Assist in implementing QHSE policies and processes, ensuring adherence to local Malaysian legislation and Aggreko's internal standards.
* **Stakeholder Liaison:** Build and maintain effective relationships with sites and depots, addressing QHSE issues and providing expert advice to all staff levels.
* **Safe Work Practices:** Monitor and support the execution of safe work processes and ensure Safe Work Method Statements are in place across all Aggreko locations.
* **Project and Tenders:** Assist in the completion of QHSE-related aspects for project tenders.
* **Accident and Risk Management:** Leads incident investigations for Malaysia and Thailand, assist in producing safety alerts, and conduct comprehensive risk assessments.
* **Training and Induction:** Deliver QHSE training and conduct inductions for new and existing employees.
* **Rehabilitation Support:** Assist with rehabilitation and return-to-work processes.
* **Regulatory Reporting:** Handle all scheduled waste reporting to DOE and annual DOSH reporting, along with other Malaysian regulatory requirements.
* **License Management:** Support, coordinate, and maintain all QHSE-related license applications for Malaysia.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Proactively identify and implement ongoing QHSE improvements in collaboration with the HSE Specialist - Asia and provide support to the Singapore business as needed.
* Support and assist direct report HSE Specialist - Asia on any other QHSE related duties and assignment.

**What we are looking for:**

* Degree in relevant field highly preferred
* Willing to travel frequently within Malaysia states and occasional support in Thailand and Singapore to attend client meeting, multiple project site and depot etc.
* Candidate needs to have a valid driving license and own transport for Malaysia interstate travel.
* **Certified Health and Safety Professional:** Possesses certifications in Health and Safety from Malaysian DOSH/DOE/BOMBA, including OSH Coordinator, Scheduled Waste Training (CEPSVAM), and CERT/First Aid courses.
* **DOSH Certified Officer:** Holds a DOSH certified Safety and Health Officer (Green Book) qualification and registered with DOSH. Candidates who possess SSS / Yellow book and in the process of completion of Green Book Certification are also welcome to apply.
* **Registered OSH Coordinator:** Able to register as an OSH Coordinator for the Malaysia JB Depot DOSH myKKP.
* **Regulatory Reporting Expertise:** Leads and is responsible for the Depot's monthly scheduled waste reporting to DOE.
* **Strong Regulatory Knowledge:** Possesses a solid understanding of Malaysia's OSH requirements (DOSH), environmental regulations (DOE), and Fire Safety Regulations (BOMBA).
* **Auditing and Compliance Experience:** Has a solid understanding and application of local regulations and compliance, preferably as a trained system auditor with prior auditing experience.
* **ISO Standards Proficiency:** Experienced with ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001 standards.
* **Strong Administrative and QHSE documentation skills:** Computer literate with MS Office proficiency, effective administrator, well-organized, methodical, and capable of working under pressure with minimal supervision.
* **Excellent Communication and Problem-Solving:** Possesses effective communication skills, strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, planning and organizing skills, and meticulous attention to detail.

**Here’s what you’ll get:**

* Competitive compensation package
* Industry-leading benefit plans
* Continuous training and development with career growth opportunities
* Safety-focused culture

Our people are can-do, positive, resilient and persistent. If that feels like you, apply now and build your career with the people bringing energy to the world.
